exposure: acetaminophen biomarkers in cord blood (unchanged acetaminophen, acetaminophen glucuronide)
cohort: Participants were children from the Boston Birth Cohort, including groups with asthma and allergic comorbidities, asthma without allergic comorbidities, and those free of asthma.
finding: Cord blood acetaminophen biomarkers were associated with an increased risk of childhood asthma without allergic comorbidities but not with asthma with allergic comorbidities.
